payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various types of offensive content explored in research, including hate speech, bullying, and insults.

claims.text: Different kinds of offensive content explored include aggression identification, bullying detection, hate speech, toxic comments, and offensive language.
Offensive content can be categorized into targeted insults, untargeted insults, threats, and profanity.
Offensive posts can target groups based on ethnicity, gender, political affiliation, or other characteristics.
There is a distinction between offensive content directed at individuals versus groups, and whether the language is explicit or implicit.
